```abap
      IF P_FIELD_INT-LANF NE 0         "Loopfeld oder TC Feld
      AND P_FIELD_INT-LTYP NE 'O'.     "außer OK-Code-feld
        IF P_FIELD_INT-LTYP = 'T'.     "Feld im Table Control
          CONT-TYPE = RPYTY_DYNP_CTYPE-TABLE_CONTROL.
          LOOP AT P_FIELD_LIST_INT     "Table Control suchen
                  WHERE FILL = 'T'     "und dessen Namen
                  AND   LANF = P_FIELD_INT-LANF. "übernehmen
            L_CONT_FOUND = 'X'.
            EXIT.
          ENDLOOP.
          IF P_FIELD_LIST_INT-FNAM NE SPACE.
            CONT-NAME = P_FIELD_LIST_INT-FNAM.
          ELSE.
            PERFORM R_CONCAT_CONT_NAME USING P_FIELD_INT-LANF
                                       CHANGING CONT-NAME.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.                          "Feld im Loop
          CONT-TYPE = RPYTY_DYNP_CTYPE-LOOP.
          PERFORM R_CONCAT_CONT_NAME USING P_FIELD_INT-LANF
                                     CHANGING CONT-NAME.
          L_CONT_FOUND = 'X'.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.                            "Feld im Universalcontainer
        "als gewöhnliches Feld im Universalcont.behandeln
        CONT-TYPE = RPYTY_DYNP_CTYPE-SCREEN.
        CONT-NAME = CONT_SCREEN_NAME.
      L_CONT_FOUND = 'X'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
* Feld im LOOP oder TC oder TS
  ELSEIF P_FIELD_INT-LANF NE 0      "Feld im Loop oder im Control
   AND P_FIELD_INT-LTYP NE 'O'.        "außer OK-Code-Feld
    IF P_FIELD_INT-LTYP = 'T'.         "Feld im Table Control
      CONT-TYPE = RPYTY_DYNP_CTYPE-TABLE_CONTROL.
      LOOP AT P_FIELD_LIST_INT         "Table Control suchen
              WHERE FILL = 'T'         "und dessen Namen
              AND   LANF = P_FIELD_INT-LANF. "übernehmen
        L_CONT_FOUND = 'X'.
        EXIT.
      ENDLOOP.
      IF P_FIELD_LIST_INT-FNAM NE SPACE.
        CONT-NAME = P_FIELD_LIST_INT-FNAM.
      ELSE.
        PERFORM R_CONCAT_CONT_NAME USING P_FIELD_INT-LANF
                                   CHANGING CONT-NAME.
      ENDIF.
    ELSEIF P_FIELD_INT-LTYP = 'I'.         "Feld im Table Control
      CONT-TYPE = RPYTY_DYNP_CTYPE-TABSTRIP_CONTROL.
      LOOP AT P_FIELD_LIST_INT         "TabStrip Control suchen
              WHERE FILL = 'I'         "und dessen Namen
```
